mechanism_narrative: Four consecutive weekly rises in RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT reflect a self-reinforcing reopening momentum that will lift RETAIL_REC further over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -9.7 to -3.3 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite continued weekly rises in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above the -40 percent baseline threshold signals restored commuting capacity, which increases retail-and-recreation footfall over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -40 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -44.1 at t-3w to -37.7 at t-0w, crossing -40
failure_condition: After TRANSIT weekly mean exceeds -40, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its mean over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in RESIDENTIAL and recovery in PARKS indicates people are leaving home for outdoor social activity, which spills over into discretionary retail footfall and raises RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -10 and RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below 5
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -20.9 to -7.3 and RESIDENTIAL fell from 6.3 to 4.0
failure_condition: When PARKS exceeds -10 and RESIDENTIAL falls below 5, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its mean over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The active reopening policy regime, evidenced by simultaneous recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from lockdown troughs, removes restrictions on retail capacity and lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.

failure_condition: During a reopening regime, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its mean over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT recovering.

mechanism_narrative: The December holiday shopping period produces a seasonal lift in RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM that is independent of commute recovery, raising RETAIL_REC over the next week.

failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than its mean over the prior 7 days during the December holiday period.

failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM is at or above 10.0, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its mean over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint weekly rise in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a commuter-return synergy that multiplies retail-and-recreation footfall beyond either series alone, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.

failure_condition: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise in the same week, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its mean over the last 28 days.
